rationale: Registered motorbikes include many scrapped but never de-registered vehicles; Vietnam has no mandatory de-registration
Urban commuting and short rural trips; motorbike use is daily but trips are short
Common workshop practice 1500-2000 km (mineral oil); OEM manuals 3000-4000 km for semi-synthetic
Scooters ~0.8 L; manual-clutch bikes ~1.0 L (owner manuals)
Cars must pass periodic inspection so the register is close to the active fleet
Private cars; ride-hailing fleets drive more
OEM service schedules for gasoline cars
Sump capacity incl. filter for 1.0-2.5 L engines
Commercial vehicles are inspected every 6-12 months
Mix of light trucks / pickups and long-haul trucks and coaches
Light commercial 5-7 L; heavy trucks 15-30 L; weighted towards light commercial
Gear/axle/hydraulic oils on top of engine oil
